questions.text: Explain the difference between evaporation and boiling.
A car travels 120 km in 2 hours. Find its speed. Show your working.

answers.1: Plants use light energy to make their own food by photosynthesis.
answers.2: Evaporation happens only at the surface of a liquid and at any temperature. Boiling happens throughout the liquid at a fixed temperature called the boiling point.
answers.3:
Speed = Distance / Time
= 120 km / 2 h
= 60 km/h
answers.4:
1. Roots absorb water and minerals from the soil.
2. Roots hold the plant firmly in the ground.

answers.2: In boiling the bubbles form only at the surface. Evaporation is slow.

answers.1: The leaves catch the sun rays and with that energy they prepare food (glucose) for the plant.
answers.4: They store food like in carrot. They also keep the tree standing in strong wind.
